speaker: narrator
text: What if you played *for* the casino?

speaker: narrator
text: Last season, Jay ran a casino. Then lost *it*.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance never sold it. Jay never read *the contract*.

speaker: narrator
text: Now Jay washes dishes at a *diner*.

speaker: bit
text: Fun fact. You still owe me *eleven dollars*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, I'm *broke*. Not now.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the bell rings. It's *Lucky Lou*.

speaker: gambler
text: You gave me my house back. I *owe* you.

speaker: narrator
text: Lou slides a crumpled paper across the *counter*.

speaker: gambler
text: Vance's contract. Read *clause nine*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Read it. *Slowly*.

speaker: bit
text: Run the house three nights. *Beat the owner*...

speaker: bit
text: ...keeps the house. *Forever*.

speaker: hero
text: Lou. You just saved my *life*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, Jay walks back into *the casino*.

speaker: owner
text: Look who's back. Did you finally *read*?

speaker: hero
text: Clause nine. Three nights. I'm the *house*.

speaker: owner
text: Then I'm the *player*. And I never lose.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance opens a briefcase. *Ten million dollars*.

speaker: owner
text: Night one starts *now*, kid.

speaker: narrator
text: Night one. Jay puts on the *suit* again.

speaker: bit
text: Welcome back, boss. I really missed the *chandelier*.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance ignores the bar and walks straight to *roulette*.

speaker: owner
text: One thousand dollars. On *red*.

speaker: dealer
text: Twenty two. *Black*.

speaker: owner
text: Two thousand. On red.

speaker: narrator
text: Black again. Three thousand gone. Vance just *smiles*.

speaker: owner
text: Four thousand. On *red*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, why does he keep *doubling*?

speaker: bit
text: It's called the *martingale*. Lose, double, repeat.

speaker: bit
text: One win pays back *every* loss.

speaker: bit
text: Plus his first thousand, as *profit*.

speaker: hero
text: Wait. So he literally can't *lose*?

speaker: bit
text: With infinite money? *He can't*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, he brought *ten million* dollars!

speaker: narrator
text: Finally, red. Vance wins a thousand. And starts *again*.

speaker: narrator
text: By midnight, Vance is up *forty thousand*.

speaker: owner
text: Two more nights, house. Tick tock. *Tick tock*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. How do you beat *infinite money*?

speaker: bit
text: Nobody has infinite money. Not even *him*.

speaker: bit
text: And every real table has a *maximum bet*.

speaker: hero
text: A limit? We *forgot* the limit?

speaker: bit
text: You set it to *unlimited*. On day one.

speaker: hero
text: Of *course* I did.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay grabs a marker and writes a *new sign*.

speaker: owner
text: Cute sign. It changes *nothing*.

speaker: narrator
text: One thousand on red. Black. Two thousand. *Black*.

speaker: narrator
text: The streak keeps going. Seven blacks. *Eight*.

speaker: owner
text: Two hundred fifty six thousand. On *red*.

speaker: dealer
text: Sorry, sir. The limit is *one hundred*.

speaker: narrator
text: The doubling *breaks*. He can't win it back.

speaker: bit
text: Vance is down *two hundred fifty five thousand*.

speaker: owner
text: You changed the rules *mid-game*!

speaker: hero
text: You taught me. Always read *the sign*.

speaker: narrator
text: Midnight. Night one goes to *the house*.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance closes his briefcase. He's *smiling* again.

speaker: owner
text: Night two, kid. I'm bringing a *friend*.

speaker: narrator
text: Behind the bar, Rosa finds an *envelope*.

speaker: narrator
text: Inside: cash. And a note. "*Tilt it.*"

speaker: narrator
text: Night two. Vance bets on one number. *Seventeen*.

speaker: dealer
text: Seventeen. *Black*.

speaker: narrator
text: One number pays thirty five to *one*. He wins.

speaker: narrator
text: Seventeen. Then twenty seven. Then seventeen *again*.

speaker: hero
text: That's *impossible*. Right, Bit? Tell me that's impossible.

speaker: bit
text: Not impossible. Just very, very *unlikely*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every spin, the vault counter keeps *falling*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay, I logged every spin *tonight*.

speaker: bit
text: Three numbers hit *five times* too often.

speaker: bit
text: A flawed wheel *favors* some numbers.

speaker: bit
text: Real players have watched wheels for *ten thousand* spins.

speaker: hero
text: So the wheel itself is *broken*?

speaker: bit
text: Or someone *broke* it.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay looks at the dealer. Rosa looks *away*.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa? Tell me it *wasn't* you.

speaker: dealer
text: Jay... I didn't want to. I'm *so* sorry.

speaker: narrator
text: The vault is down to *fifty thousand*.

speaker: owner
text: One more spin and the house is *mine*.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance pushes every single chip he has onto *seventeen*.

speaker: hero
text: Stop the wheel! House rules. *Inspection*.

speaker: owner
text: You can't stop a *spin*!

speaker: bit
text: Your own contract says *he can*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay lifts the wheel. Under it, a tiny *coin*.

speaker: narrator
text: Stamped with a single letter. *V*.

speaker: hero
text: Rosa. You were my friend. *Why*?

speaker: dealer
text: Vance owns my debt. Forty *thousand*.

speaker: dealer
text: Tilt the wheel, or lose my *apartment*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay knows that feeling. He has *been* there.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. New wheel. *Perfectly* level.

speaker: narrator
text: Same bet. Fair wheel. The ball *spins*.

speaker: dealer
text: Four. *Black*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every chip Vance won tonight is *gone*.

speaker: owner
text: Fine. Fine! Night two goes to *the house*.

speaker: owner
text: And Rosa? You're *fired*.

speaker: hero
text: She doesn't work for you. She works for *me*.

speaker: dealer
text: Jay... nobody ever stood up for me. *Thank you*.

speaker: owner
text: Tomorrow, no wheels. No cards. Just *one coin*.

speaker: narrator
text: One flip. Heads or tails. Winner takes *everything*.

speaker: narrator
text: Midnight. Jay can't *sleep*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. A coin flip is *fair*, right?

speaker: bit
text: Fifty fifty. The fairest bet *there is*.

speaker: hero
text: Then why am I *scared*?

speaker: bit
text: Because you remember *old Jay*.

speaker: narrator
text: Old Jay lost ten bets straight. And kept *going*.

speaker: hero
text: I always thought the next one was *due*.

speaker: bit
text: Monte Carlo, nineteen thirteen. Black hit *twenty six* times.

speaker: bit
text: People bet against black. They lost *millions*.

speaker: bit
text: A wheel has no *memory*. Neither does a coin.

speaker: narrator
text: Knock knock. It's Lou. And *Rosa*.

speaker: gambler
text: I almost lost my house to a *feeling*.

speaker: dealer
text: Don't let him turn you into *old Jay*.

speaker: hero
text: But if I don't flip, I *lose* everything.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Read the contract. *Again*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit highlights two words. *Three nights*.

speaker: hero
text: Not one flip. All three *nights* together.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. How far ahead *are we*?

speaker: bit
text: Exactly... *eleven dollars*.

speaker: narrator
text: Night three. The whole city came to *watch*.

speaker: owner
text: Heads or tails, kid. Casino against *everything*.

speaker: hero
text: *No*.

speaker: owner
text: No?

speaker: hero
text: The house doesn't have to play. You *taught* me.

speaker: narrator
text: The crowd *boos*. Someone yells "coward".

speaker: owner
text: Fine. Then I'll play your *machines*. Every one.

speaker: narrator
text: Vance pulls slot after slot after slot. *All night*.

speaker: bit
text: Every pull, the house edge earns us *pennies*.

speaker: narrator
text: Eleven fifty nine. Vance is losing. He's *desperate*.

speaker: owner
text: No records? Then no *winner*.

speaker: narrator
text: He rips Bit's cable out of the *wall*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay... the ledger... *saving*...

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Bit, no! Stay with me!

speaker: bit
text: Sending everything to your *phone*.

speaker: bit
text: No room left for... *me*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then Bit's little screen goes *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay's phone buzzes. Ledger *received*.

speaker: narrator
text: Midnight. Three nights. The house wins *all three*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay won the casino. But he lost *Bit*.

speaker: narrator
text: The casino is Jay's now. *Forever*.

speaker: narrator
text: But Jay isn't celebrating. He's rebooting his *friend*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit? It's me. *Jay*.

speaker: bit
text: Hello. I am Bit. Who is *Jay*?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay tries everything. He even shows Bit the *chandelier*.

speaker: bit
text: That is a *lamp*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa sings. Lou dances badly. Nothing *works*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit... remember? I still owe you *eleven dollars*.

speaker: bit
text: Eleven dollars... You *still* haven't paid me!

speaker: hero
text: Bit! You're *back*!

speaker: bit
text: Memory restored. Debt *also* restored.

speaker: narrator
text: Next morning, Jay makes *one change*.

speaker: narrator
text: Chips are free now. Nobody can bet *real money*.

speaker: hero
text: Everybody plays. Everybody laughs. Everybody goes *home*.

speaker: narrator
text: Rosa runs the floor. Lou greets every *guest*.

speaker: narrator
text: And the first customer in line? *Mr. Vance*.

speaker: owner
text: I've got a new system. I *can't* lose.

speaker: hero
text: Sir, the chips are free. *Nobody* loses.

speaker: owner
text: Then what's the *point*?

speaker: bit
text: *Exactly*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for a new What if every day.
